#### dirichletEllipse (quasistationary)

Quasistationary linear elasticity on a non-trivial geometry: a large ellipse
with two smaller ellipses cut out of it, each of them carrying its own material
number. All three contours are prescribed with
`StationaryLinearElasticityMRTDirichletValidation`, which imposes the
displacement of the manufactured solution on the curved boundary, so the case
measures how well the boundary scheme follows a geometry that is not aligned
with the lattice.

The `run.sh` script performs the same resolution sweep and order of convergence
study as `quasistationary/periodicPlate`.
